If the raw value for a date-valued property is not a string,
warn and discard the property value.

If the invalid raw is the only value for the property, as in this test,
discard the property.

-- test.glx --
citations:
  some-citation:
    properties:
      # accessed is a date-valued property and 3 is not a string.
      accessed: 3

-- want-error --
citations\[some-citation\].Properties.accessed.Value: cannot parse int as date

-- want-catalog.yaml --
citations:
    # empty object because the only property was discarded
    some-citation: {}
